headline: Traders expect ECB rate increase
summary: The European Central Bank raised borrowing costs and lifted its inflation forecast. Traders began bracing for rate hikes extending into next year, amid another oil price jump tied to the Iran war.
why: The ECB sets interest rates for the euro area, and its decisions influence euro-area bond yields, the euro and equity valuations.

source.name: Shafaqna English | International Shia News & Fatwas

why_moved: A rate increase and a higher inflation forecast, combined with rising oil prices, pushed traders to price in further ECB hikes.
